=== FILE: client-extensions/library-web-custom-element/client-extension.yaml ===

    - from: build/static
      into: static
library-web-custom-element:
    cssURLs:
        - css/main.*.css
    htmlElementName: library-web-custom-element
    name: Library
    type: customElement
    urls:
        - js/main.*.js
=== END FILE ===

=== END FILE ===
